Garden Care Plans

How It Works

Simple and Reliable

Choose Your Plan

Three Tiers of Care

Monthly

Essential

One visit per month

Monthly maintenance to keep your garden tidy, healthy, and in good order. The foundation of a well-cared-for property.

Includes

  • Lawn mowing & edging
  • Hedge touch-up trimming
  • Weeding of garden beds
  • General tidying & cleanup
  • Seasonal adjustments

Best for: well-maintained gardens needing regular upkeep.

Enquire About Essential
Most Popular

Fortnightly

Premium

Two visits per month

Fortnightly visits for a consistently immaculate garden. More frequent attention means the garden is always in top condition — not just the week after a visit.

Includes

  • Fortnightly mowing & edging
  • Regular hedge shaping & trimming
  • Weeding & garden bed care
  • Mulching top-up (seasonal)
  • Shrub & plant pruning
  • Full site cleanup each visit

Best for: homeowners who want a consistently pristine garden.

Enquire About Premium

Bespoke Schedule

Estate

Tailored to your property

A fully bespoke maintenance programme for large acreage properties, equestrian estates, and gardens with complex maintenance requirements. We visit as often as the property needs.

Includes

  • Bespoke visit schedule
  • All mowing & edging
  • Full hedging programme
  • Complete garden maintenance
  • Mulching & seasonal work
  • Priority scheduling

Best for: Hills District acreage and large Upper North Shore estates.
